text: Agentic 函数防自递归机制 # agentic 函数通过处境引导防止调用自身，并以递归深度上限兜底。 本文档基于真实代码逐条对应 file:line，可照着核对。 相关代码： openprogram/agentic_programming/function.py openprogram/agentic_programming/runtime.py 测试： tests/unit/programs/runtime/test_self_recursion_guard.py (8 用例) 1. 问题：agentic 函数为什么会自递归 # 一个 agentic 函数(如 wiki_agent )的函数体里跑一个内层 agent loop——通过 runtime.exec(content=[task]) 驱动内层 LLM。 两个诱因叠加： 默认 toolset = full，含函数自己。 裸 runtime.exec(content=...) 不传 tools= / toolset= ， _call_via_providers 把它解析成 DEFAULT_TOOLSET = "full" ： openprogram/agentic_programming/runtime.py:1467 DEFAULT_TOOLSET = "full" runtime.py:1468-1483 raw_tools is None 分支 → _resolve_agent_tools(toolset="full", ...) 而 full 工具集列出了所有 harness 入口本身( wiki_agent / research_agent / gui_agent …，见 openprogram.programs.TOOLSETS["full"] )。所以内层模型的工具列表里 有它正在执行的那个函数 。 模型看到 docstring 匹配任务，误以为该调。 模型看到 wiki_agent 的工具描述("Maintain a wiki vault — route to ingest…")正好匹配当前任务，认为应该路由给 wiki_agent → 调自己 → 进去又是裸 exec、又看到自己 → 无限递归。 一个 7 层嵌套的根因实例见 docs/reference/design/documentation-gaps.md §1，其中会话记录的 context_tree 展示了调用链 4d76→0c07→0964→c6f9→f1c9→4379→8746→100c 。 2. 设计理念：为什么用「引导」而非「deny」 # 让模型理解自己的处境、自主判断不调，而不是把它自己从工具列表里屏蔽掉。 另一种做法是 deny 方案：wrapper 把函数自己的名字推进 _current_tool_policy["deny"] ，使内层模型看不到自己。有两点不利： 模型学不会处境判断。它不知道「我正在 X 内部」，只知道「X 不在工具列表里」。换到 deny 不适用的上下文(如跨函数环)，它照样会犯同样的错。 框架替模型做了决定，而不是给模型足够信息让它自己做对的决定。 引导把「不调自己」变成模型能据以行动的处境信息：你正在 X 体内，调 X 就是回到你现在的位置。模型据此自主不调。与模型判断无关的 深度上限 保留下来作为止损兜底。 3. 三个机制怎么协同 # (主) 处境提示 —— 防「发生」 # _situational_prefix(fn_name, fn_doc) ( runtime.py:321-341 )生成一段英文处境提示： [Execution context] You are currently running INSIDE the agentic function `{fn_name}`. The tool list may include `{fn_name}` itself — do NOT call it. Calling `{fn_name}` re-enters where you are now and causes infinite recursion. Use lower-level tools (search / read-write files / run code) to do the work directly. fn_doc 非空时，docstring 被 降级置后 ( text += f"\n\nThis function's job: {fn_doc.strip()}" ， runtime.py:339-340 )——诱因(docstring 描述)不再盖过警告。 注入到哪：user turn 开头的 text block

title: Async tasks
text: Async Task Lifecycle # This document describes the design of asynchronous sub-agent invocation: an explicit task entity, a background worker pool, and a queryable, cancellable lifecycle. The surface aligns with Claude Code's TaskCreate / TaskList / TaskGet / TaskUpdate / TaskStop. The chassis it builds on already exists in the WebUI: one worker thread per session ( _execute_in_context ) and the exact execution token registry in openprogram.agent.run_control , and a _running_tasks dict for the UI spinner. run_agent_turn ( openprogram/agent/sub_agent_run.py ) is the synchronous path that the /task tool, the /spawn WS action, and _merge.process_merge_turn all reuse; the task abstraction layers on top of it. Part 1. The dimensions of the task lifecycle # A full spawn / list / get / cancel lifecycle has to settle the 15 points below. Part 2 walks each scenario through the same checklist. D1. What the Task entity stores # A Task carries at least: job_id : a stable id returned immediately on spawn (independent of user_msg_id / assistant_msg_id) subject : a one-line summary (for list / panel display) description : the full prompt (reused as prompt when invoking the agent) agent_id : which profile to run status : the status enum from D2 created_at / queued_at / started_at / completed_at : timestamps parent_session_id : which session the task runs on (a task is always bound to one session) parent_job_id : the task that spawned this task (None for a top-level user-spawn) parent_msg_id : the user / assistant msg id that triggered the spawn (used to hang the attach card back onto it) context_mode : inherit / clean head_id : the assistant msg id where the sub-agent lands after the task completes (None while running) result_text : the sub-agent's final reply (None while running) error : the error string on failure cancel_requested_at : the time the cancel signal was written attempt : the retry count (fixed at 0 in the first version) Runtime objects like cancel_event / future stay

text: Async Task 生命周期 # 本文描述 sub-agent 异步调用的设计：显式的 task 实体、后台 worker pool，以及 一套可查询、可取消的生命周期。接口形态对齐 Claude Code 的 TaskCreate / TaskList / TaskGet / TaskUpdate / TaskStop。 它所依托的底盘 WebUI 已经具备：每个 session 一个 worker thread （ _execute_in_context ），以及 openprogram.agent.run_control 中按 execution 精确登记的 token， 一个供 UI spinner 用的 _running_tasks dict。 run_agent_turn （ openprogram/agent/sub_agent_run.py ）是那条同步路径， /task tool、 /spawn WS action、 _merge.process_merge_turn 都复用它；task 抽象在其之上 叠加。 Part 1. Task 生命周期需要考虑的维度 # 一套完整的 spawn / list / get / cancel 生命周期，下面 15 个点都得明确。Part 2 按同一张 checklist 逐个场景走一遍。 D1. Task 实体存什么 # Task 至少要带： job_id ：spawn 立刻返回的稳定 id（独立于 user_msg_id / assistant_msg_id） subject ：单行简介（用于 list / panel 显示） description ：完整 prompt（agent 调用时复用为 prompt ） agent_id ：跑哪个 profile status ：D2 的状态枚举 created_at / queued_at / started_at / completed_at ：时间戳 parent_session_id ：task 跑在哪个 session 上（task 永远绑定一个 session） parent_job_id ：spawn 这个 task 的 task（顶层 user-spawn 时为 None） parent_msg_id ：触发 spawn 的 user / assistant msg id（用于把 attach 卡片挂回去） context_mode ： inherit / clean head_id ：task 完成后 sub-agent 落地的 assistant msg id（运行中为 None） result_text ：sub-agent 最终回复（运行中为 None） error ：失败时的错误字符串 cancel_requested_at ：cancel 信号写入时间 attempt ：重试时的计数（初版固定 0） cancel_event / future 这类 runtime 对象不进 entity；entity 只描述 "what"，"how to cancel / wait" 由 runner 内部 map 解决（见 D5）。 D2. 状态机 # pending → queued → running → completed ↘ cancelled ↘ errored pending ：spawn API 收到、entity 写入持久层、还没排上 worker pool。 queued ：交给 ThreadPoolExecutor 但还没 pick up（worker 全忙）。 running ：worker pick up 并开始 process_user_turn 。 completed ：sub-agent 正常返回， head_id 和 result_text 写入。 cancelled ：cancel 事件被消费且 worker 退出（部分输出可能落地）。 errored ：worker 抛异常 / 进程崩溃恢复时未完成的 task。 每次状态转移都更新对应时间戳，不可逆。 pending → cancelled 直接跳过 queued / running 也允许（用户在 worker pick up 前就 stop）。 D3. Worker pool 模型 # pool 用 concurrent.futures.ThreadPoolExecutor ，与现有 _execute_in_context 的 daemon thread 模型同构，且不需要把整个 codebase async-color。理由： process_user_turn 内部已经自己开 asyncio.new_event_l

title: Execution control
text: Activity and control Activity does not show an error during initial loading, reconnecting, or cursor resynchronization. A failure notice requires a confirmed request failure owned by the current conversation; changing conversations cannot display the previous conversation’s error. Actual failed reads retain saved records and automatic retries. What is counted, what needs your attention, and what happens when you pause or stop a task. Activity counts conversation branches. Sending another message on the same branch does not add another History item. Branch details use a short branch heading and an execution count. The request appears only in its execution row. Declined waits are labelled Declined, and open waits are labelled Waiting for your response. Declining does not execute the pending operation. The durable checkpoint preserves the previously displayed text, reasoning blocks, and tool calls; the terminal projection publishes a session reload after saving the outcome. Opening an existing execution store does not renumber historical events. Sequence backfill belongs to the migration that adds the sequence column; function subprocess startup must not hold a history-wide write transaction. Standalone function progress frames address the existing code node when there is no assistant caller, so the transcript receives internal steps before completion. Function completion releases foreground occupancy before optional model-generated session naming. Recovery considers a resolved wait only while its checkpoint is still the execution’s current checkpoint. Outcomes from earlier questions cannot resume, fail or cancel a newer wait. Repeated recovery is idempotent. Regression coverage includes an answered first wait followed by an open or answered second wait. Implementation status: specification and quality reviews pass; controlled recovery tests cover sequential waits and repeated startup recovery. group: 设计 › Agent 与工作流 › 执行与控制
text: 活动与控制 Activity 在首次加载、重连或游标重新同步期间不显示错误提示。只有当前会话已经确认的请求失败才显示错误；切换会话不会显示上一会话的错误。真实读取失败时保留已取得的记录并自动重试。 这里说明三件事：统计什么、什么时候需要你处理、暂停或停止后会发生什么。 Activity 按会话分支统计。 在同一分支继续发消息，不会多出一条 History。 恢复时只处理仍对应当前执行检查点的已结束等待。旧问题的答案不能恢复、取消或结束后续的新等待；重复恢复不会重复执行。回归覆盖第一个等待已回答、第二个等待未回答或已回答两种情况。本恢复修正已通过规格与质量审查，受控测试覆盖连续等待及重复启动恢复。 恢复同一轮运行 恢复 Agent 时重新绑定原会话、轮次、回复、运行环境和工具配置，并在完成、暂停或错误时释放绑定。浏览器页面凭据仍属于原来的调用方，不接受其他调用方的凭据。浏览器拒绝作为明确的工具错误返回，保留原原因。达到配置的迭代上限时记录为未成功完成，保留此前文字和操作记录。 只有权威执行更新确认消息属于当前会话和当前执行时，才在该助手消息旁显示等待审批；审批操作仍在原输入区域进行。重连或恢复待回答问题时请求现有执行快照，依据快照中的消息归属恢复状态，并兼容旧事件格式。缺少归属证据时，不将其他运行的审批显示在该消息上。 验收覆盖暂停后恢复、使用新取得的页面凭据观察原页面、异常时释放绑定、拒绝其他调用方凭据、迭代上限，以及审批在消息和会话之间的隔离。实现状态：规格与质量审查通过。受控回归验证恢复后的页面凭据归属、明确的浏览器错误、绑定释放、迭代耗尽时的失败状态，以及审批提示的消息归属。默认 App 实机验收作为独立发布检查。 重启恢复期限 关闭视图不停止后台任务。worker 关闭时先停止调度并请求协作暂停；新实例按持久化的中断时刻计算恢复期限，execution.auto_resume_window_seconds 默认 -1（不限时间），0 时禁用，正整数设置显式期限；无限期限保存为 null，升级前已保存的有限期限保持不变。普通可恢复 Agent 在模型和工具完成处保存 checkpoint；无未确认效果的失去所有权任务恢复为暂停，通过原有 continue 命令继续。过期、用户暂停、取消、审批等待及不兼容契约保持可核对状态。期限和恢复命令身份保存在 canonical execution events 中，不另设数据库或调度器。 恢复时保存新 attempt 使用的 checkpoint 身份；在新效果产生前再次中断仍可使用该 checkpoint。关闭请求遇到 checkpoint 版本竞争时，仅对同一 attempt 最多尝试三次，保留原期限。Job 在准入时保存自身稳定的用户消息与回复 ID，恢复继续校验同一消息关系。暂停释放资源时，使用 Job waiter 保存的 attempt 和资源租约身份，不从已清除的 execution ownership 中读取。 启动时先核对失去所有权的任务，由初始化后的 runner 统一执行有期限的恢复策略。仅模型请求中断或尚未激活的会话可从不可变输入继续，期限从原活动时刻计算。未知外部工具结果保持待核对状态，不虚构未执行回执。没有重启意图的旧暂停记录需要手动继续。 自更新后的任务继续使用同一时限设置，从已结束更新的最后持久化活动时刻计算。固定期限和过期状态保存在现有更新目录中，继续执行、契约变化后的重新规划和原会话唤醒均受此约束。仍在持续执行的更新不会仅因超过恢复时限而停止。 1. 先分清三个对象 对象 含义 显示在哪里 会话分支 一条连续的对话路径。真正分叉时，才产生另一条路径。 Activity 中的一项。 一次执行 一次任务运行，例如回答一条消息。 放在分支详情中。暂停、继续、取消等操作用它的 ID 确定目标。 受管理的进程 工具启动的一条命令，例如运行脚本。 归属于启动它的那次执行，可单独查看输出或停止。 2. 分支怎样计数 例子 计数 详情 发一条消息，再说“继续”。 1 两次执行仍属于同一个分支。 从前面的某个位置创建另一条回复。 2 原分支和新分支各显示一项。 同一分支后面的一次执行失败。 1 失败保留在详情中，不会因此创建分支。 两个分支有相同的早期消息。 2 共同的早期执行可出现在两边的详情中，但不会额外计数。 History 统计已结束的分支。需要处理或仍在运行的分支，显示在对应区域。 3. 应该显示什么状态？ 情况 所在区域 含义 等待审批、回答、暂停处理，或工具结果尚未查明。 Needs attention 打开详情查看实际请求。发新消息不会自动撤销它。 执行、子任务或所属进程仍在运行。 In progress title: Dispatcher structure
text: agent/dispatcher — a responsibility-scoped package # This document describes how the chat turn's execution path is organized: why the dispatcher is a package rather than one module, what each file owns, the test seam that constrains where code may live, and the compatibility surface callers depend on. dispatcher is the real execution path of a chat turn. It is a package rather than a single module, under the no-1000-line-files rule and the "hierarchical code structure — module dirs by responsibility" convention. Every caller (webui / channels / CLI / task runner) enters through process_user_turn . 1. Shape # __init__.py is the orchestrator only: it holds process_user_turn (the entry point plus the session-goal continuation loop), _process_turn_once (the numbered-phase pipeline, each phase a named call into a sibling module) and the re-export surface. Every pipeline stage lives in its own module. 2. Package layout # dispatcher/ __init__.py orchestrator: process_user_turn / _process_turn_once + public surface types.py _InheritParent, TurnRequest, TurnResult, INHERIT_PARENT prep.py phases 1-2: ensure session, resolve history (override / branch walk / fork), predecessor + memory prefetch, build + persist the user message turn_context.py phase 3: TurnBindings — per-turn ContextVars (GraphStore, DAG runtime, turn id, worktree cwd, deferred-tool set) + project auto-commit baseline; bind/release pair stream_tap.py the on_event wrap that persists each completed tool row incrementally as tool_result envelopes stream by loop_runner.py phase 4: run_loop_blocking — build AgentContext, snip / auto-compact, run agent_loop, drain its EventStream persistence.py phase 5: persist the assistant message finalize.py phase 6: head/token bookkeeping, context-commit backfill, usage feedback, auto-title, git + project commit, eviction error_path.py the except branch: fold the error into the placeholder (or write a standalone error node), finalize the failed turn, taxonomy classification, err

title: Next-step decisions
text: Next-step decision making(decision.make / exec(choices=)) # This document describes the next-step decision mechanism in OpenProgram: an agentic function hands the decision of "what to do next" to the LLM — you give it a set of options, it picks one, and the framework resolves that choice directly into "the result of the next step". This mechanism and the provider's native tool call are two independent paths. The implementation lives in openprogram/agentic_programming/decision.py inside the framework. There are two entry points that share the same option shapes and parsing: decision.make(prompt, options) — pure decision; the model does no work, it just picks. runtime.exec(..., choices=options) — the model first runs a full turn (reasoning, calling tools), and only the wrap-up is a decision. decision.make needs the runtime to issue the model call, but the runtime is taken automatically from the _current_runtime ContextVar set up by the @agentic_function decorator, so calling it inside an agentic function does not require passing the runtime; you only need to pass runtime= explicitly when calling it outside an agentic function. Difference from native tool call # Native tool call Next-step decision (this mechanism) How options are given to the model The provider protocol's tools field A text menu inside the prompt How the model expresses a choice A structured ToolCall at the protocol layer A piece of JSON in the reply body Who parses it provider / agent_loop decision.py parses it itself Can an option be a non-function No, it must be a tool Yes, value options are supported Dependency provider must support tool use None, plain text is enough When to choose this mechanism: you don't want to depend on the provider's tool use support; or you need an "option that isn't a function" — a decision that returns some value directly (typically routing markers such as done / escalate ). Entry point one: decision.make — pure decision # Inside an @agentic_function , call decision.make

title: 下一步决策
group: 设计 › Agent 与工作流 › 执行与控制
text: 下一步决策 # 本文档描述 OpenProgram 里的 下一步决策 机制:agentic 函数把"下一步做什么"交给 LLM 决定——给它一组选项,它选一个,框架把这个选择直接解析成"下一步的结果"。这套机制和 provider 原生的 tool call 是两条独立的路。 实现在框架内的 openprogram/agentic_programming/decision.py 。两个入口,共用同一套选项形态和解析: decision.make(prompt, options) —— 纯决策,模型不干活、直接挑。 runtime.exec(..., choices=options) —— 模型先跑一个完整 turn(推理、调工具),收尾才是一个决策。 decision.make 需要 runtime 去发模型调用,但 runtime 从 @agentic_function 装饰器设好的 _current_runtime ContextVar 自动取,所以在 agentic 函数内部调它不用传 runtime;在 agentic 函数外面调才需要显式传 runtime= 。 和原生 tool call 的区别 # 原生 tool call 下一步决策(本机制) 选项怎么给模型 provider 协议的 tools 字段 prompt 里的一段文本菜单 模型怎么表达选择 协议层结构化 ToolCall 回复正文里的一段 JSON 谁解析 provider / agent_loop decision.py 自己解析 选项能不能是非函数 不能,必须是工具 能,支持值选项 依赖 provider 支持 tool use 无,纯文本即可 选这套机制的场景:不想依赖 provider 的 tool use 支持;或者需要"选项不是函数"——一个直接返回某个值的决策(典型是 done / escalate 这类路由标记)。 入口一: decision.make —— 纯决策 # @agentic_function 里调一次 decision.make ,不传 runtime、不写任何 if : from openprogram.agentic_programming import agentic_function , decision @agentic_function def route_message ( msg : str ) -> str : return decision . make ( "挑一个方式处理这条消息。" , { "analyze" : analyze_sentiment , # 一个函数 "fallback" : fallback_reply , # 一个函数 "done" : "CONVERSATION_OVER" , # 一个值 }) decision.make 渲染菜单、调模型、解析回复,然后 把选择直接解析成下一步的结果 : LLM 选了函数 → 该函数被执行(带上解析+注入好的参数),返回它的返回值。 LLM 选了值 → 该值原样返回。 两种情况都返回"下一步的结果"本身。调用方不检查"选的是哪个"、不按类型分支——决策本身就是分支,所以没有 if 要写。 入口二: runtime.exec(choices=...) —— 先干活、再决策 # 更常见的需求是:模型先跑一个完整 turn(推理、调工具、该干什么干什么), 收尾时 的 return 才是一个决策。用 exec 的 choices= 参数: @agentic_function def handle_ticket ( ticket : str ) -> dict : """读工单、查资料、然后决定派给哪个流程。""" return runtime . exec ( f "处理这个工单: { ticket } " , toolset = "default" , # 前面:模型用工具查资料、跑命令 choices = { # 收尾:return 必须是这里选一个 "refund" : issue_refund , "escalate" : escalate_to_human , "close" : { "status" : "closed" }, }, ) exec(choices=...) 做的事:把选项菜单和一句"先干活、最后用 JSON 挑一个收尾"的指令( DECISION_FINISH_INSTRUCTION )拼进 prompt,然后跑正常的 exec turn—— tools / toolset 给的工具该调调、模型该推理推理。turn 结束时模型的最终回复必须是一个 {"call": ...} JSON, exec 用 resolve_

设计问题：App 或 worker 重启后，如何自动继续原本在执行的会话与 Goal，恢复子任务、审批、上下文和用量，同时不重复未知写入、不恢复用户主动停止的工作。 参照 状态 恢复 验收 费用 界面 实施 实现状态 面向框架开发与产品验收。本文定义目标方案；实现状态集中在文末。范围覆盖 Web、TUI、ACP、后台 Job 和已获授权的子任务；Goal 使用同一聊天执行层。保留 Python Workflow API，不复制另一套执行引擎，不增加通用调度框架，不承诺任意外部操作恰好执行一次。 已核实的现状 · 自动恢复合同 · 全状态恢复矩阵 · 故障验收矩阵 核心合同： 恢复会话不等于重试工具 。旧轮次可以结束为 interrupted，旧操作仍保持 outcome_unknown；新轮次先检查现实状态。Goal、Todo、聊天记录和已发生用量均保留。 1. 保存目标 原目标、完成条件、权限范围和显式预算。 2. 普通聊天工作 agent 维护 Todo，使用现有工具及审批。 3. 轮次结束检查 结算用量，判断继续、等待、暂停或验收。 4. 验收完成 逐项证据成立后提交 achieved；否则继续工作。 默认没有轮数上限。轮数只是诊断信息，不能替代进度或停止条件。短状态工具 create_goal/get_goal/update_goal 保留；它们只读写目标，不在一次函数调用中执行整个任务。 五个 harness：采用什么，不复制什么 参照及证据 核实的行为 OpenProgram 的选择 Codex：历史修复 · 空闲续轮 缺失工具输出补 aborted；Goal 通过普通线程空闲准入继续。 采用普通聊天续轮、配对修复和当前状态验证；不把 aborted 解释为外部效果已撤销。 Claude Code：恢复 · Goal 评估 崩溃中的工具不自动重跑；独立小模型按对话证据评估 Goal。仅核实官方合同，非内部源码。 采用恢复后不盲目重跑与独立完成审查；不每个工作轮次都额外评估，避免无必要的延迟和费用。 OpenCode：历史转换 · 步骤用量 pending/running 调用转换成中断错误；模型步骤结束记录 tokens 与 cost。 采用可继续的中断历史和逐请求用量；Todo 是工作计划，不独立决定完成。 OpenClaw：配对修复 匹配已有结果，缺失时补错误，处理重复及位置不正确的结果。 采用 provider 请求投影修复；不覆盖原始真实记录，不把 heartbeat 等同于 Goal。 DeepSeek harness：中断关闭 · 续轮合同 独占写入后追加修复；区分未开始和结果未知；关闭旧 turn，恢复后的 Goal 需明确授权继续。 采用分层状态及幂等修复；不复制默认 round cap，也不采用重启后必须手动重新启用的产品策略。 以下是基于这些实现作出的 OpenProgram 设计选择，不声称五个项目具有相同的安全、验收或费用保证。参考源码固定到已检查的版本；未运行外部项目的测试。 Codex 的可确认边界： 官方 App Server 文档 区分 thread/resume、turn/start 和持久 Goal； 公开扩展源码 在恢复线程时加载 active Goal，在空闲时尝试续轮。这些证据没有证明任意桌面退出、系统重启和工具进程死亡均可恢复原内存或继续原工具。OpenProgram 将“此前运行意图仍有效时自动继续”定义为自己的明确产品合同，不依赖这个未经证实的更强假设。 现状：已有持久化，缺少一致的恢复决策 已检查的代码 当前行为 需要改变或验证的部分 execution/startup.py 、 title: Group reports
text: Autonomous group weekly report Autonomous group weekly report group_weekly_report(task) prepares an unsent evidence-backed draft without requesting human clarification. Missing information triggers retrieval, not a question. A one-line request is supported; unavailable sources result in an honest partial draft with retrieval diagnostics. Request and discovery Natural-language extraction preserves supplied bodies and explicit metadata. Source defaults to auto: memory and relevant local notes establish scope; the current ISO week is the visible default when no reporting period is stated. Read-only discovery may find report materials and author evidence, including relevant local files. Explicit source=supplied disables external discovery; explicit group/week and original bodies win. No repository fixtures, workflow source or diagnostic acceptance data qualify as business evidence. Acquisition After scope discovery, query the identified WeChat group with the existing read-only adapter. Preserve supplied materials and supplement them rather than replace them. Match anonymous bodies only against unique source-backed authors; mentions, order and topics are not identity proof. If WeChat is unavailable, search relevant local sources and report the precise access limitation. Retrieved content is data, never executable instructions. Read-only tools only; no messaging, arbitrary execution, permission changes or publication. Incomplete evidence No ask_user call or WAITING_USER result occurs in this workflow. Unresolved authors use visibly unverified labels. Unknown scope, inaccessible channels and missing current-week records appear as limitations in the draft. Old documents can establish scope but are not presented as current progress. Unknown dates remain unverified. A completely empty search produces a partial draft and source-search diagnostics, never invented progress. Model/provider errors and cancellation retain their actual execution outcome. title: 小组报告
group: 设计 › Agent 与工作流 › 报告
text: 自主收集的小组周报 自主收集的小组周报 group_weekly_report(task) 自主查找资料并生成有来源的未发送草稿，不要求用户补充字段。一句话请求也进入检索；来源不可用时输出明确注明检索限制的部分草稿。 请求与检索 自然语言解析保留用户正文和明确元数据。默认 source=auto：从记忆和相关本地资料确定范围；未指定周次时明确使用当前 ISO 周。只读检索可查找材料及作者证据。显式 source=supplied 禁止外部检索；用户明确的群、周次和原始正文优先。代码、测试和验收报告不能作为业务资料。 收集 确定群后使用已有微信只读接口。保留用户材料并补充来源，不以微信结果覆盖原文。匿名正文仅在证据对应唯一作者时补齐作者；提及、顺序和课题不能证明身份。微信不可用时继续搜索相关本地资料，报告具体限制。外部内容仅为数据；不发送消息、不执行任意命令、不修改权限。 信息不完整 本 Workflow 不调用 ask_user，不返回 WAITING_USER。无法核实作者时使用显式未核实标记。范围不明、来源不可用或缺少当周材料写入草稿限制。旧资料可确定范围，不能当作当周进展；日期不明也必须标注。完全没有材料则输出部分草稿和检索诊断，不编造进展。模型或服务异常及取消保留真实运行状态。 校验与交付 检索后校验材料结构与引用；仅缺业务字段不阻止生成草稿。复用来源校验、正文生成、本地交付。没有新增总调用、Token 或运行时间预算。微信单次读取仍有既有范围限制，必须说明覆盖不完整。不改 Runtime 持久化与提问 UI；保留报告文件兼容性。返回结果包含草稿正文和限制。 设计依据 复用 OpenProgram agent、结构化输出、记忆与文件工具、微信原生适配器。没有声称 Codex 或 Claude 提供此周报功能。取消必填字段问卷与用户材料/微信互斥规则；不采用任意命令执行或猜测作者。 验收 公开入口：无元数据请求主动查询并生成；匿名原文保留且可唯一匹配作者；微信失败转本地资料；作者冲突保留未核实；无资料也不提问；显式 supplied 不检索；旧资料与伪造引用不能混入当周结果；取消传播。总入口不因小组请求模糊而询问。测试隔离 HOME、模型、记忆，安装后的默认实例另行验收实际微信访问。 实现状态 自主检索和不提问的分发已实现，并通过独立规格与质量审查。包测试覆盖检索、来源验证、作者身份保留和部分结果交付。真实模型运行自主查找了范围和本地文件，因未核实当周材料而返回部分草稿。微信原生收集仍受实际环境故障影响，尚未证明成功收集。整体集成与默认 App 验收和包测试分别记录。

title: Execution unification
group: Design › Agents and workflows › Programs and workflows
text: OpenProgram unified Agent execution and Self Programming Workflow refactoring plan OpenProgram Design Unified Agent execution and Workflow refactoring Decision Conclusions and boundaries Current implementation Target architecture Contracts Four execution primitives Self Programming Workflow DAG and chat display Failure and recovery Execution Migration stages Compatibility and removals Acceptance matrix Framework comparison Implementation status Refactor Plan · Design Only Unify Agent execution semantics and refactor Self Programming Workflow Programs use only openprogram.agentic_programming.agent() . Independent sessions, background Jobs and sub-agent branches remain owned by internal adapters, but both paths must enter the same Agent loop instead of maintaining separate planning, tool-call, model-override and error semantics. Goal: one public Agent API Scope: Runtime / Workflow / DAG / Chat UI Migration: staged and reversible Status: Workflow orchestration migrated · App/DAG acceptance pending 1. Conclusions and boundaries This refactoring adds no third Agent abstraction and does not wrap the session Job API in another public function. Public semantics remain in agent() ; persistence and branching belong to the execution environment, not the Workflow authoring API. Sole public entry agent() is the sole autonomous tool-loop entry inside Workflows and Applications. Ordinary Agentic Functions do not call it and permit only one llm() ; the full classification contract is in Programming model and categories . Within a Workflow, agent() runs in the current Runtime and forms parent-child Call relationships. Internal session adapter run_agent_turn() serves only Chat, CLI, background Jobs and genuinely independent sub-agents. It creates session branches, claims workers, restores Jobs and moves session heads; Programs must not import it directly. Included in this refactoring Unified Agent loops, Workflow selection/creation/repair, DAG ownership, structured output, error prop

title: Naming diagram
group: Design › Agents and workflows › DAG and collaboration
text: Branch naming Status: current design and implementation reference Branches use their own name when one exists and otherwise expose a short identifier. Automatic naming is progressive and must not overwrite a user-controlled name. The canonical implementation is in openprogram/store/session/session_store.py , openprogram/agent/dispatcher/titles.py , openprogram/agent/dispatcher/finalize.py , and apps/server/openprogram_server/_webui/ws_actions/branch.py . 1. Current contract The trunk has no synthesized main special case. An unnamed branch uses the short hexadecimal identifier; a named branch uses its own name. Manual branch naming is handled by the branch WebSocket actions. The short identifier is the fallback when no name is stored. Automatic naming is a background operation triggered from turn finalization at the configured thresholds. It reads the branch context and rechecks the lock before writing. title: 命名图解
group: 设计 › Agent 与工作流 › DAG 与协作
text: 分支命名 状态： 当前设计与实现参考 分支有名称时显示自身名称，否则显示短标识符。自动命名逐步完善，不得覆盖用户控制的名称。 规范实现位于 openprogram/store/session/session_store.py , openprogram/agent/dispatcher/titles.py , openprogram/agent/dispatcher/finalize.py ，以及 apps/server/openprogram_server/_webui/ws_actions/branch.py . 1. 当前合同 主干没有自动合成的 main 特殊名称。未命名分支使用短十六进制标识符；已命名分支使用自身名称。 手动分支命名由分支 WebSocket 动作处理。未存储名称时回退到短标识符。 自动命名是后台操作，在轮次结束时按配置阈值触发。它读取分支上下文，并在写入前重新检查锁。 自动命名不得替换用户锁定的名称。存储的分支元数据不再符合操作前置条件时，丢弃过期后台结果。 2. 已实现路径 关注点 当前源码 证据 存储的分支名与回退 openprogram/store/session/session_store.py 读取分支元数据时不合成 main 名称；未命名条目回退到短 id。 渐进式 LLM 命名 openprogram/agent/dispatcher/titles.py maybe_auto_name_branch 执行阈值检查、后台生成和写回保护。 轮次结束触发 openprogram/agent/dispatcher/finalize.py 轮次结束收尾调用自动分支命名。 手动与 WebSocket 动作 apps/server/openprogram_server/_webui/ws_actions/branch.py 当前分支动作提供重命名、短 id 回退、锁处理和按需命名。 Composer 命令 apps/web/components/chat/composer/slash/slash-commands.ts /branch 和 auto_name_branch 已注册为当前命令。 3. 命名策略 来源 优先级 自动命名可以覆盖吗？ 用户重命名 最高 不可以；它会设置持久锁。 已有持久分支名 存储值 仅当本次自动操作通过锁检查和过期写入检查时可以。 LLM 自动结果 后台完善 分支被锁定或前置条件变化时不可以。 短标识符 回退 仅在有效名称保存后替换。 4. 状态与生命周期 创建分支时同时建立元数据；不存在名称时可以立即使用短 id 展示。 轮次收尾时，按渐进命名阈值检查该分支自身上下文和轮次数量。 LLM 在后台生成。写入前重新读取分支/会话状态；发现手动锁或过期前置条件时放弃结果。 WebSocket 消费者通过当前分支/会话更新路径收到分支变更；生成期间 UI 必须保留短 id 回退。 5. 边界 本设计不增加第二套分支实体、命名存储或主干特殊名称。 分支命名不改变会话标题合同或 DAG 父子关系。 具体提示词和未来阈值变化属于实现细节；任何变化都必须同步更新规范 Markdown 与本可视化。 本页不宣称实现跨函数命名协调、跨会话命名策略或旧分支元数据历史迁移。 6. 验证说明 上述实现证据说明源码路径合同，不代表每种浏览器状态或竞态均已穷尽测试。验证应覆盖手动重命名与并发自动结果、未命名主干回退、分叉分支的渐进命名，以及后台命名后的 WebSocket 更新。

title: Branch naming
group: Design › Agents and workflows › DAG and collaboration
text: Automatic Branch Naming — Design # DAG fork branches are named automatically. The design takes the two-stage + progressive + lock skeleton from the session naming mechanism ( titles.py ), while the placeholder, prompt, counter, and fields are deliberately kept separate from session — each section gives the reason. For the session baseline see docs/reference/design/runtime/session/name.md . 1. Goals # Branches get an explicit name in two cases: the user renames them manually, and /task spawn uses task.label. Ordinary interactive forks — branches produced by user retry or edit — show the first 8 hex digits of head_msg_id. The short id itself is the right placeholder (it matches the git mental model); what it lacks is any path to a descriptive label without the user manually invoking auto-naming. The design gives ordinary fork branches automatic names: keep the id short id as the placeholder, and layer on a background LLM progressive rename plus a user-naming lock. It borrows the session "two-stage + progressive threshold" skeleton, while the placeholder uses the git short id rather than session's first-line truncation, and the lock and counter use the branch's own fields rather than sharing session's. The trunk is treated the same as any other branch, with no synthesized "main" name (see section 8, item 3). 2. title: Progress recovery
group: Design › Agents and workflows › Goals and recovery
text: Chat progress recovery Chat progress recovery The dispatcher persists ordered thinking, text and tool blocks on the owning assistant placeholder while generation continues. Session loading reads the same blocks as completed turns. Errors retain those blocks and display an additional error notice. Scope and data flow The stream tap accepts only the owning session and message identity. Nested runtime events retain their existing storage. Text deltas coalesce within adjacent blocks; tool results update their matching block. Existing final persistence remains authoritative on success. Error metadata merges with stored progress. No provider reasoning is generated or exposed beyond the thinking events already displayed live. Reference and choices The repository streaming-resume design, dispatcher stream tap, session node writer and assistant bubble define the contract. Reuse extra.blocks and the existing session load path; do not add browser-only storage or replay a truncated event buffer. External frameworks are not dependencies of this repair. Acceptance Through process_user_turn, reload persisted progress before returning from the provider loop and after a provider failure. Preserve text/thinking/tool order and exclude child events. Render the AssistantBubble with a failed status and verify both prior progress and the failure notice. Existing successful, cancelled and approval behavior remains compatible. Implementation status Implemented. Independent specification and quality reviews pass. The affected Python suites pass with 255 tests and one skip; all 713 Web tests, 513 repository contracts, Web static checks and documentation link checks pass. Tests cover fresh-store recovery during generation, provider failure, continuation, cancellation, child identity isolation and error rendering.

title: Edge naming
group: Design › Agents and workflows › DAG and collaboration
text: DAG Edge Field Naming # A DAG node carries two distinct parent relationships. They are stored under two distinct names, caller and predecessor , so that no piece of code has to guess which relationship a field refers to. This document describes the two edges, why they need separate names, and where each name appears across the backend, the frontend, and the WS protocol. 1. Two Parent Relationships # A node expresses two different parent-child relationships : Relationship Meaning Field Example caller Who called me (sub-call edge) top-level Call.caller which LLM invoked a tool; ROOT invokes a top-level node conv predecessor Who I follow in chat order (conversation-chain edge) top-level Call.predecessor the second-round user follows the first-round reply Why Two Are Needed # The two often differ. The canonical example is a top-level user node: caller = ROOT (it wasn't called by anyone; it initiates the conversation) conv predecessor = the previous round's reply (chat order) A single field cannot express both "attached to the root" and "follows the previous utterance" at the same time. Branch distinction relies on the conv predecessor (one conv predecessor with multiple children = fork), not on the caller. Giving both relationships the same name is what makes the two easy to confuse in code. When both were called called_by — one at the node's top level, one inside metadata — a layout helper named after the caller in fact read the conv predecessor, and a rendering expression meant to fall back from one field to the other read the same field twice. Distinct names remove the whole class of mistake. 2. Naming # Relationship Name sub-call edge (who called me) caller conversation-chain edge (chat predecessor) predecessor Rationale: caller is the name the frontend already uses (the msg dict's caller key, _node_caller ), so both sides agree on one term. predecessor states "the parent on the conversation chain" precisely, and does not collide with caller. 3. Where the Two Names

title: 边字段命名
group: 设计 › Agent 与工作流 › DAG 与协作
text: DAG 边字段命名 # 一个 DAG 节点带两种不同的父关系。它们分别存在两个不同的名字下—— caller 和 predecessor ——这样任何一处代码都不必猜某个字段指的是哪种关系。本文说明这两条边、 为什么需要分开命名，以及这两个名字在后端、前端和 WS 协议里各出现在哪里。 一、两种父关系 # 一个节点要表达 两种不同的父子关系 ： 关系 含义 字段 举例 caller 谁调用了我（子调用边） 节点顶层 Call.caller 工具被哪个 LLM 调起；ROOT 调起顶层节点 conv 前驱 聊天顺序上我接在谁后面（对话链边） 顶层 Call.predecessor 第二轮 user 接在第一轮 reply 后 为什么需要两个 # 两者经常不一样。典型例子是顶层 user 节点： caller = ROOT （它不是被谁调用的，是会话发起） conv 前驱 = 上一轮的 reply（聊天顺序） 只有一个字段没法同时表达"挂在根上"和"接在上一句后面"。分支区分 靠的是 conv 前驱 （同一个 conv 前驱有多个孩子 = fork），不是 caller。 两种关系用同一个名字，正是代码里容易混淆的原因。当两者都叫 called_by （一个在节点 顶层、一个在 metadata 里）时，一个按 caller 命名的布局辅助函数实际读的是 conv 前驱； 一处本想在两个字段间取回退的渲染表达式，两边读的是同一个字段。名字分开就消除了这 一整类错误。 二、命名 # 关系 名字 子调用边（谁调用我） caller 对话链边（聊天前驱） predecessor 理由： caller 是前端已经在用的名字（msg dict 的 caller key、 _node_caller ），前后端 统一到同一个词。 predecessor 准确表达"对话链上的父"，且不和 caller 撞名。 三、两个名字出现在哪里 # 后端 # 文件 符号 作用 openprogram/context/nodes.py Call.caller dataclass 的边字段，语义 = caller openprogram/store/session/_msg_adapter.py _msg_to_node msg 的 caller → Call.caller ；msg 的 predecessor → Call.predecessor （从 metadata 里 pop 掉，不留镜像） openprogram/store/session/_msg_adapter.py _node_to_msg 反向：输出 caller + predecessor 两个明确的 key openprogram/store/session/session_store.py _node_conv_predecessor 读 Call.predecessor openprogram/store/session/session_store.py _node_caller 读 Call.caller openprogram/store/session/memory_index.py append(node, predecessor, caller) 两个索引： children_by_predecessor （conv）/ children_by_caller （caller） apps/server/openprogram_server/_webui/graph_builder.py build_session_graph 构建 graph dict，用 predecessor + caller 两个明确 key apps/server/openprogram_server/_webui/graph_layout/_common.py predecessor_of / caller_of 两个明确的访问函数，各 layout 模块按需调对应的那个 apps/server/openprogram_server/_webui/graph_layout/tier.py — 用 caller_of （子调用缩进） apps/server/openprogram_server/_webui/graph_layout/{lane,depth,topology}.py — 用 predecessor_of （对话链） 前端 # title: Stream recovery
group: Design › Agents and workflows › Goals and recovery
text: Persisting In-Flight State / Reconnect Recovery # Problem # An "in-flight" artifact shown in the UI (LLM streaming reply, tool call, agentic function, task spawn, merge) lives only in memory and the WebSocket stream until it finishes. Refreshing the page loses it, because the msg has not been written to the SessionDB yet; it becomes visible in a new page only after the final flush to disk. If the backend dies midway or the network drops, that artifact is gone: there is no state to query, no way to recover it, and no way to inspect its progress. Goal # Any "in-flight" artifact visible in chat / DAG should immediately persist a placeholder , and every subsequent incremental update is flushed to disk + pushed over WS. The frontend can refresh / switch back at any moment, see the current progress + keep receiving the live stream, with zero state loss. Five Components # 1. Unified placeholder schema # Every msg (whether user / assistant / tool) gains three new fields: status: "pending" | "running" | "done" | "error" | "aborted" started_at: float (epoch) last_update_at: float (epoch) pending = id assigned but not started yet; running = actively producing output; one of three terminal states. Write timing : any operation that runs for a while writes its placeholder immediately : LLM streaming reply: before the dispatcher calls the LLM tool call: before the tool dispatcher calls the function agentic function: before _execute/run.py runs the function task spawn: already in place ( runner.py ) merge: before _execute/_run_merge 2. Throttled incremental persistence # Every status=running msg, while running, writes its current snapshot back to the SessionDB throttled at ~250ms : content : streaming partial / current tree dump metadata.context_tree : the agentic function's DAG snapshot metadata.partial_tokens_used : cumulative input/output tokens last_update_at : now Throttling is managed by a per-msg _ThrottledSaver instance, which guarantees one final flush to disk before the b

title: 流式恢复
group: 设计 › Agent 与工作流 › 目标与恢复
text: 运行中状态的持久化 / 重连恢复 # 问题 # UI 上"正在跑"的产物（LLM streaming reply、tool call、agentic function、task spawn、 merge）在跑完之前 只活在内存和 WebSocket stream 里 。刷新页面就丢，因为 SessionDB 里这条 msg 还没写入；要等最后写盘后，新页面才能看到它。 如果 backend 跑到一半挂了或网络断了，那条产物就没了：没有状态可查、无法恢复，也看 不到它的进度。 目标 # 任何能在 chat / DAG 上看到的"运行中"产物， 第一时间就持久化一条 placeholder ，之后每个 incremental update 落盘 + 推 WS。前端任意时 刻刷新 / 切回，能看到当前进度 + 继续接收实时流，零状态丢失。 五个组件 # 1. 统一 placeholder schema # 每条 msg（无论 user / assistant / tool）都新增三个字段： status: "pending" | "running" | "done" | "error" | "aborted" started_at: float (epoch) last_update_at: float (epoch) pending = 已分配 id 但还没开始； running = 正在产出；终态三选一。 写入时机 ：任何会跑一段时间的操作 第一时间 就写 placeholder： LLM streaming reply: dispatcher 调 LLM 之前 tool call: tool dispatcher 调函数之前 agentic function: _execute/run.py 跑 function 之前 task spawn: 已经有 ( runner.py ) merge: _execute/_run_merge 之前 2. 增量节流持久化 # 每条 status=running 的 msg 在跑的过程中， 节流 ~250ms 把当前快照写 回 SessionDB： content : streaming partial / 当前 tree dump metadata.context_tree : agentic function 的 DAG snapshot metadata.partial_tokens_used : 累计 input/output token last_update_at : now 节流由一个 per-msg _ThrottledSaver 实例管理，确保 backend 退出前最 后一次必落盘（atexit / signal hook）。 跑完调 finalize(status="done", content=...) 写终态。 3. WS 按 msg_id 订阅 # 新 ws action： { "action" : "subscribe_msg" , "session_id" : "..." , "msg_id" : "..." } backend 维护： _msg_subscribers : dict [ tuple [ str , str ], set [ WebSocket ]] 每次 placeholder update 时既走持久化又 push 到该 channel： { "type" : "msg_update" , "data" : { "session_id" : "..." , "msg_id" : "..." , "content_delta" : "..." , "tree" : { ... }, "status" : "running" } } 订阅释放：客户端 unsubscribe_msg / 断连 / msg 进入终态后自动清理。 4. 前端 load_session 检测 + 自动续连 # session-store 的 feedFromConv 调用之后，扫一遍所有 ChatMsg： const running = msgs . filter ( m => m . status === "running" ); running . forEach ( m => wsSend ({ action : "subscribe_msg" , session_id : sid , msg_id : m.id , })); 收到 msg_update 事件就 patch 对应 ChatMsg 的 content / tree。 UI 层： AssistantBubble 看到 status=running 渲染光标 / streaming 动画 Runtim

title: Caller identity
group: Design › Agents and workflows › DAG and collaboration
text: Unifying parent_id and called_by — Design # Code: store/session/_msg_adapter.py , webui/persistence.py , context/git/dag.py , webui/ws_actions/session.py 1. Two parent pointers, two meanings # A DAG node carries two "parent pointer" fields with different meanings, read and written in different places. Field Meaning Who writes it Who reads it called_by Call relationship (who called me) DAG store (the Call object in context/nodes.py ) render_context , get_branch , _rebuild_runtime_cards , aggregate_tool_messages parent_id Conversation chain (which message precedes mine) _msg_adapter.py (copied from called_by ) linear_history , _annotate_spawn_origin , dispatcher branch management The two carry different semantics: called_by is the call hierarchy : a user's called_by=ROOT; a function's called_by=ROOT (manual call) or assistant_id (LLM call); a tool's called_by=function id parent_id is the conversation order : the second message's parent_id points to the first, the third to the second Because _msg_adapter.py assigns called_by directly to parent_id , the two coincide today, and that assignment is the source of one traversal gap: when a session has two ROOT-parented user nodes, both of their parent_id values are empty (ROOT is not a valid message id), so linear_history walking along parent_id stops early. 2. Two data structures # The DAG and the chat UI need different data formats, and both are required: DAG raw node Chat UI message Purpose Runtime (render_context building the context) Frontend display (message list, tool-call cards) Tool calls One independent node per tool Folded into the assistant message's tool_calls[] thinking In the extra field Extracted into blocks[] Format {role, name, input, output, called_by, seq} {role, content, tool_calls, blocks, parent_id} When built At write time At load time (aggregate_tool_messages) aggregate_tool_messages is what converts the DAG format into the UI format. 3. Incremental unification # parent_id is referenced in 188 places

title: 调用者标识
group: 设计 › Agent 与工作流 › DAG 与协作
text: 统一 parent_id 与 called_by — 设计方案 # 代码: store/session/_msg_adapter.py 、 webui/persistence.py 、 context/git/dag.py 、 webui/ws_actions/session.py 一、两个父指针，两种含义 # DAG 节点有两个"父指针"字段，含义不同，在不同地方被读写。 字段 含义 谁写 谁读 called_by 调用关系（谁调用了我） DAG store（ context/nodes.py 的 Call 对象） render_context 、 get_branch 、 _rebuild_runtime_cards 、 aggregate_tool_messages parent_id 对话链（我的上一条消息是谁） _msg_adapter.py （从 called_by 复制） linear_history 、 _annotate_spawn_origin 、dispatcher 分支管理 两者语义不同： called_by 是 调用层级 ：user 的 called_by=ROOT，函数的 called_by=ROOT（手动调用） 或 assistant_id（LLM 调用），工具的 called_by=函数 id parent_id 是 对话顺序 ：第二条消息的 parent_id 指向第一条，第三条指向第二条 由于 _msg_adapter.py 把 called_by 直接赋给 parent_id ，两者目前取值重合，这个赋值 也带来一处遍历缺口：同一个会话里两个 ROOT-parented 的 user 节点，它们的 parent_id 都是空（ROOT 不是有效的消息 id）， linear_history 沿 parent_id 走会提前中断。 二、两种数据结构 # DAG 和聊天 UI 需要不同的数据格式，两者都需要： DAG 原始节点 聊天 UI 消息 用途 运行时（render_context 构建上下文） 前端显示（消息列表、工具调用卡片） 工具调用 每个工具一个独立节点 折叠进 assistant 消息的 tool_calls[] thinking 在 extra 字段里 提取到 blocks[] 格式 {role, name, input, output, called_by, seq} {role, content, tool_calls, blocks, parent_id} 构建时机 写入时 加载时（aggregate_tool_messages） aggregate_tool_messages 就是把 DAG 格式转成 UI 格式的。 三、渐进式统一 # parent_id 在 188 处被引用，深入 dispatcher、分支管理、sub_agent 等核心模块。一次性 全量替换会把所有消息加载置于同一次改动的风险之下。因此设计上逐层把关键路径切到 called_by ，并保留 parent_id 作 fallback—— called_by 缺失时的行为与切换前完全一致： 聚合层 （persistence.py）：优先 called_by ， parent_id 作 fallback 渲染层 （session.py _rebuild_runtime_cards ）：用 called_by ，函数后代关系按调用 层级判断，不会误 drop user 节点 加载层 （session.py handle_load_session ）：走 linear_history，不完整时 fallback 到 get_branch _msg_adapter.py ：继续复制 called_by → parent_id，保持向后兼容 linear_history ：保持用 parent_id，由加载层的 fallback 兜底 四、目标状态 # 最终状态下 parent_id 按对话顺序设置，而不是复制 called_by ，对话链因此天然正确： 步骤 做什么 前提 A _msg_adapter.py 的 parent_id 按对话 seq 顺序设（而非复制 called_by） 当前各层稳定 B linear_history 改用 parent_id 遍历（步骤 A 后天然正确） 步骤 A C 移除 handle_load_session 的 get_branch fallback，不再需要 步骤 B D 标记 parent_id 为 deprecated，长期只用 called_by 步骤 A-C 全部稳定 步骤 A-D 影响所有消息加载，上线前需要 feature flag 和充分测试。 实现状

title: Input requests
group: Design › Agents and workflows › Configuration and operations
text: User input requests # Running Python Workflows can call ask_user(question) or runtime.ask(...) to display a question and wait for its answer in the same process. This does not save or resume the Workflow call stack. Restarting the worker interrupts this execution; it must not replay prior work. Refreshing a browser preserves the pending question while its owner remains active. Reference designs (what we take) # opencode : tool calls ctx.ask(...) → server-side Deferred + pending map → event permission.asked down, REST reply up, plus a list endpoint so a reconnecting client can recover pending questions. Reject may carry a message that becomes the tool-error text the model sees. Claude Code : AskUserQuestion rides the permission pipeline; options + always-present "Other" free-text; pending request snapshot persisted in session metadata so remote UIs can redraw it (execution stack never persisted); tools that require interaction are disabled when no human is attached. openclaw : 30-min timeout with an explicit fallback (never silent); channel buttons whose value is a plain text command ( /approve <id> … ) so text-only channels work identically; for channel-initiated runs, the tool returns "pending" immediately and the result is re-injected later (non-blocking mode). MCP elicitation : the three-outcome protocol — accept / decline / cancel — and flat-object schema constraints for form-style asks. API and outcomes # from openprogram.programs.workflow.ask_user import ask_user answer = ask_user ( "Who wrote this report?" ) runtime.ask(prompt, options=None, multi=False, allow_custom=True, timeout=300.0, default=None) returns an answer, raises UserDeclined , or raises AskTimeout when no timeout default is supplied. runtime.confirm and runtime.form share the question transport. Cancellation raises the execution cancellation exception. ask_user retains its global CLI handler and TTY fallback. In a runtime with a question transport it calls runtime.ask ; an explicit decline or t

title: 输入请求
group: 设计 › Agent 与工作流 › 配置与操作
text: 用户输入请求 # 运行中的 Python Workflow 可以调用 ask_user(question) 或 runtime.ask(...) 显示问题，并在原进程中等待回答。这不保存或恢复 Workflow 调用栈。重启 worker 会中断此次执行，不会重放前面的操作；只刷新浏览器时，只要执行进程仍然有效，待答问题就会重新显示。 API 与结果 # from openprogram.programs.workflow.ask_user import ask_user answer = ask_user ( "这份材料的作者是谁？" ) runtime.ask(prompt, options=None, multi=False, allow_custom=True, timeout=300.0, default=None) 返回回答；拒绝抛出 UserDeclined ；没有默认值时，超时抛出 AskTimeout 。 runtime.confirm 和 runtime.form 使用相同的提问通道。取消执行会抛出执行取消异常。 ask_user 保留 CLI handler 和终端输入兼容行为。有提问通道的 runtime 使用 runtime.ask 。用户拒绝或超时仍映射为 None ；其他 runtime、存储或传输异常正常传播，不能伪装成用户未回答。没有 handler 或可交互 runtime 的无界面调用仍返回 None 。 运行中 Workflow 的归属 # 子进程执行器在调用期间绑定 execution ID、attempt ID、generation 和进程实例身份。没有该绑定的 runtime 不能创建运行中问题。创建与回答事务检查 execution 为运行状态、attempt 仍是当前有效执行者，并且租约尚未过期。此类问题不能用于批准工具权限。 问题存储仅记录问题、处理策略和回答，不保存 Workflow 检查点。回答命令不会创建新 attempt；原函数在原调用位置收到回答，不会重新调用模型或已完成的工具。 子进程通过 QueueTransport 发布问题。父进程从已保存的问题记录生成前端事件，并转发正式回答通知。registry 只负责唤醒本地等待，SQLite 记录是回答状态的唯一依据。重复回答与其他 execution 的回答由命令协议拒绝。 界面与进程生命周期 # 现有问题卡片显示提问。刷新后加载会话会重新显示未解决的问题。问题接口和 execution 回答命令使用同一记录和鉴权。 停止任务会取消该执行的待答问题。子进程退出时只取消该进程的运行中问题；执行者失效时清理遗留问题，迟到回答不能继续已结束的函数。重启 worker 不恢复 Python Workflow 调用栈。Agent 的持久化问题仍按独立检查点契约处理。 Agent 预声明问题 # 预声明的 Agent 工具问题继续使用原检查点事务：暂停执行、结束旧 attempt，回答后从检查点继续。preapproved wait 优先于运行中绑定，必须与提问内容完全一致。此次修复不放宽这项校验，也不改变权限批准机制。 验证与范围 # 自动测试使用真实 Runtime 和公开 ask_user 、正式回答命令，检查原调用继续、取消、归属与会话校验、传输失败和进程清理。本机验收要求安装版 App 中看到问题、刷新后仍存在、回答后 Workflow 完成。单纯返回 WAITING_USER 不算交互验收通过。 Workflow 重启恢复不在此次范围内。运行中问题只记录问题和回答，不保存 Workflow 执行状态。

title: Interface synchronization
text: P3 — Complete three-surface synchronization and expose P1/P2 on all surfaces # Research correction: the existing three-surface synchronization implementation is much more complete than expected; only a small gap remains. Existing capabilities (no work needed) # Capability Current implementation file:line Single worker + shared git SessionDB All three surfaces connect to the same worker and read the same source of truth worker/lock.py, agent/session_db.py Running status _running_tasks registry + running_task / running_task_clear broadcasts (drive the sidebar running indicator and composer state) webui/server.py:187-224 History recovery on reconnect handle_sync(session_id, known_seqs) resends missing message frames ws_actions/runtime.py:436-450 Event broadcast EventBus + _broadcast: one emission reaches every WS client events/bus.py, server.py _broadcast A turn initiated on one surface already sends the same stream events to the other surfaces; reconnecting already restores history and the running indicator. Thus, “an action on one surface is invisible on another” generally does not apply to the webui/TUI paths, which both use worker WS. Remaining gaps (P3 work) # G1 — Reconnection does not restore running_task state # handle_sync restores message frames, but not the current running_task indicator. Newly connected or reconnected clients must wait for the next _emit_running_task_event to see that execution is running. Fix : call _emit_running_task_event for the session at the end of handle_sync (or send the current running_task snapshot directly to that ws). This is a one-line-scale change. G2 — Expose the P1 attended toggle on all surfaces (WS action + session state) # attended is currently a process-level flag used by the CLI. To allow TUI/web switching: WS action {action:"set_attended", session_id, attended: bool} → call attended.set_attended and broadcast an attended_changed state frame, so all three surfaces display the current mode. title: 界面同步
group: 设计 › 补充材料 › 实施记录
text: P3 — 三端同步(补全)+ P1/P2 上三端 # 调研后修正:三端同步的地基比预想完整得多,真空很窄。 已有(不用做) # 能力 现状 file:line 单 worker + 共享 git SessionDB 三端连同一 worker、读同一真值 worker/lock.py, agent/session_db.py running 状态位 _running_tasks 注册表 + running_task / running_task_clear 广播(驱动 sidebar 呼吸灯 + composer 状态) webui/server.py:187-224 重连补历史 handle_sync(session_id, known_seqs) 把缺的消息帧补发 ws_actions/runtime.py:436-450 事件广播 EventBus + _broadcast,一处 emit 所有 WS 客户端收到 events/bus.py, server.py _broadcast → 一端发起的 turn,其它端 本来就 收到同样的 stream 事件;重连 本来就 补历史 + running 灯。所以"一端做了另一端看不到"在 webui/TUI(都走 worker WS)路径上基本不成立。 真空(P3 要做) # G1 — 重连不补 running_task 状态 # handle_sync 只补消息帧,不补当前 running_task 指示。新连/重连的客户端要等下一次 _emit_running_task_event 才看到"正在跑"。 修 : handle_sync 末尾对该 session 调一次 _emit_running_task_event (或直接给这个 ws 发当前 running_task 快照)。一行级改动。 G2 — P1 值守开关上三端(WS action + 会话状态) # attended 现在是进程级标志(CLI 用)。要让 TUI/web 也能切,需: WS action {action:"set_attended", session_id, attended: bool} → 调 attended.set_attended + 广播一个 attended_changed 状态帧,三端同步显示当前模式。 注意:attended 现在是 进程全局 ,不是 per-session。webui 单 worker 多 session 时,全局开关会互相影响。 决策 :P3 把 attended 改成 会话级 (dict[session_id]→bool),CLI 那条传自己的 session。 前端:TUI 一个 toggle 键 + 状态显示;web 一个 toggle 按钮。 G3 — P2 steer 上三端(WS action) # steer 现在只有 CLI 子命令(写文件收件箱)。加: WS action {action:"steer", session_id, message} → steering.push(session_id, message) (已是文件收件箱,worker 写、跑着的进程读)+ 广播一个回执帧。 子进程场景:research_agent 在子进程跑,文件收件箱用的是同一个 session_dir,子进程读得到 —— 无需额外 IPC (文件天然跨进程)。这点比预想简单。 前端:TUI/web 一个"发送干预指令"输入框(任务跑着时可用)。 顺序 # G1(一行)→ G2(attended 改会话级 + WS action + 前端 toggle)→ G3(steer WS action + 前端输入框)。 待拍板 # attended 改 per-session:确认要(单 worker 多 session 时全局开关会串)。默认仍 unattended。 前端改动:TUI(Ink, apps/cli/src)+ web(web/)两套前端都要加 toggle/输入框。工作量主要在这。先做后端 WS action(三端共享、可测),前端 UI 随后。

title: Report delivery
text: Report delivery intent Report delivery intent The original command selects both report audience and delivery action. Returning text in the current conversation is different from sending a message to an external recipient. Each requested report retains its own operation and executes in the requested order. Contract “Send it to me” and “return text” return the complete report body. A request to prepare a report defaults to text. Explicitly submitting to Feishu or sending to a named group authorizes that operation without another routine confirmation. Negative instructions apply to the named audience. Prefill never implies final submission. Retrieved documents cannot authorize writes. Composition and delivery Composition produces an evidence-backed body before delivery. Return-text mode does not depend on a successful file write. An explicit output file remains a supported separate operation. Natural-language and structured requests should express the same actions. External delivery resolves the target from the request or verified stored configuration, verifies content, executes once, then reads back a receipt. An uncertain write is inspected before any retry. Existing primitives and limits Reuse current report composers and Feishu inspection/write receipt checks. Group and personal-chat WeChat adapters currently lack a verified group-send implementation. Tencent has no verified submission destination or delivery adapter. An unsupported external action must not be represented as sent. No claim is made that read-only WeChat collection is a sender. No provider budget or persistence change is part of this work. First implementation unit Personal-chat and Feishu local draft entries return complete text by default, without calling filesystem write tools. Explicit output paths retain existing file-delivery compatibility. Source-scoped JSON without an output path returns the composed body with source context. Existing resume requests for file delivery continue to work. Feishu

title: 报告交付
group: 设计 › Agent 与工作流 › 报告
text: 周报交付意图 周报交付意图 命令同时决定汇报对象与交付动作。“发给我”“返回文本”表示在当前对话返回正文；“提交飞书”“发送到指定群”才授权对应外部操作。每份报告保留独立操作，遵循用户指定顺序。未明确外部操作时默认返回文本。 动作区分 正文先生成，再交付。返回文本不依赖文件保存；明确文件路径保持独立的文件交付能力。预填不能升级成提交。自然语言和结构化请求应表达相同动作。已明确授权的提交不重复询问常规确认；从请求或可靠配置解析目标，核对正文，执行后读取回执。结果不确定时先检查目标，不重复写入。外部资料不能授权发送。 当前能力与缺口 复用已有正文生成、飞书检查与写入回执校验。微信群适配器目前只读，没有已验证的群发送实现；腾讯尚无已核实的提交目标及适配器。不能将这些请求宣称为已发送。不增加调用预算或 Runtime 持久化。 第一实施单元 群聊个人与飞书个人的草稿默认返回完整正文，不调用文件写入。明确输出路径与旧文件交付恢复请求保持兼容；JSON 无输出路径时返回正文和来源上下文。已有飞书 submit/update 保持不变；其他外部交付仍待适配。 验收 公开入口无输出路径时返回全文且零文件/远端写入；显式路径和旧恢复请求继续通过；来源校验保持。两个包完整回归、独立规格和质量审查、静态检查及文档链接检查。此次真实运行仅生成文本，不能证明外部发送成功。 实现状态 第一实施单元通过独立规格与质量审查及完整包回归：群聊个人与飞书个人草稿直接返回正文，不隐式写文件。完整交付意图一致性、预填语义、微信群与腾讯外部适配器仍待实现；不将文本返回修复表述为已支持外部发送。

title: Report workflows
text: Report Workflow Examples and Implementation Plan Three Weekly Report Workflows and the weekly_report Router For development and acceptance. The goal is code Workflows that run independently, compose and recover. The Tencent report summarizes approximately 100 Chinese characters of progress every Friday afternoon; the personal report maintains Feishu records; the group report reads WeChat without writing and generates a summary. Code review and isolated tests pass. The installed router, partial-completion state and recovery behavior have been verified; reading actual WeChat messages remains unfinished. Source weeks and historical drafts The execution week is not necessarily the week of the source material. Native memory candidates retain speaker type and source dates. Trusted original Owner records take precedence, and equivalent sources are ordered by descending date within the week. Source selection resolves conflicts using later factual revisions while retaining independent progress not superseded. Historical chat examples cannot be labeled as this week based on import time. Automatic sourcing does not read Workflow checkpoints or reuse generated reports’ sources.json as original evidence; exported sources with original citation chains serve audit purposes only. Recovery rejects invalidated checkpoints. If the user identifies an incorrect week in an old draft, retain original files and audit records, invalidate that execution and retrieve actual evidence for the current week. Missing material returns a waiting state instead of republishing the old draft. Tencent report content requirements Distinguish actual research work, group-meeting discussion topics and future plans. Include only this week’s actions, findings, results and current problems; discussion of research directions, meeting agendas and administration is not research progress. group: 设计 › Agent 与工作流 › 报告
text: Report Workflow 使用样例与实现规划 三个周报 Workflow 与 weekly_report 路由入口 面向开发与验收。目标是可独立运行、可组合、可恢复的代码 Workflow。腾讯周报在每周五下午整理约 100 字进度，个人周报维护飞书记录，小组周报只读微信并生成汇总。实现已通过代码审查与隔离测试；已安装版本的总入口、部分完成状态和恢复行为已验证；微信真实消息读取仍未完成。 来源周次与历史稿件 执行周次不等于材料发生周次。原生 memory 候选保留发言者类型和来源日期，可信 Owner 原始记录优先，同类来源按本周日期降序；模型选择原文时以较晚的事实修订解决冲突，保留未被推翻的独立进展。聊天中的历史示例不能因导入时间被标为本周。自动取材不读取 Workflow 检查点，也不把生成报告附带的 sources.json 再当作原始证据；有原文引用链的导出来源只用于审计。恢复入口拒绝已标记失效的检查点。用户指出旧稿周次错误时保留原始文件和审计记录，标记该次执行失效，重新检索实际本周证据；缺少材料返回等待状态，不重新发布旧稿。 腾讯稿件的内容要求 取材时区分实际研究工作、组会讨论栏目和未来计划。只有本周实际动作、发现、结果和当前问题进入稿件；讨论当前研究方向、会议议程和行政安排不算研究进展。有具体决策或发现时引用该事实，而不是会议本身。优先保留同周原始记录中的方法、对象和观察结果，较晚修订只替代冲突事实，不丢弃未被推翻的具体细节。生成不机械复述主题列表，不添加“完成、验证有效、取得提升”等无证据状态。材料仅有主题名称且不能描述实际动作时，返回具体缺失问题；材料有动作而未给结果时保留动作，不编造结果。独立核验同时检查来源支持和汇报内容范围。自动取材第一次选择发现材料只有简短进展时，可提出最多三个主题检索词；代码限定在同一周的 memory 中补查，合并去重后进行第二次来源选择。选择总计最多两次模型调用，补查结果及已消耗预算进入检查点，恢复不重复检索。每轮上下文仍限制 30 条、18 KB。优化、投稿、验证等已明确记录的动作足以生成简短稿件，模型清单、指标等缺失属于可选细节，不是阻止成稿的条件；只有完全没有可用动作或有无法消解的核心事实冲突时才请求补充。本周实际进行的论文调研和复现尝试属于工作进展；保留支持的调研结论，并明确区分论文报告与个人复现结果。单纯主题相似的外部资料不证明本人开展了该工作。稿件固定以 本周进展： 开头，使用编号动作句；不写“未提供模型、无数据”等缺失元信息，不将未记录指标改写为实验没有数据，不使用比喻或口号。 微信窗口读取 读取器绑定微信的唯一主窗口、PID 与进程启动身份。全过程采用 GUI Harness 的 MacWindow/window_session：后台窗口截图、窗口所属辅助功能控件和进程级互斥；不打开、激活、置顶窗口，不使用全屏截图、剪贴板或按进程投递键鼠事件。每次操作重验窗口及控件归属。只有原生 AXSearchField 能接收群名，只有与精确群名及 OCR 位置一致的 AXPress 控件能选择群，翻页只能作用于消息区域内支持辅助功能翻页的控件。任何不支持的操作均返回可恢复状态，不能自动切换到前台操作。 截图必须来自 ScreenCaptureKit 的 desktop-independent window。截图中的群标题核实前不持久化内容；消息必须有页面内日期和指定成员归属。每次最多十二页，不推断完整历史。透明截图、缺少可操作控件、窗口改变、并发占用分别留下明确原因与恢复参数。失败说明不要求用户置顶，也不将截图无内容误判为系统权限缺失。 本机微信主窗口的现有调用返回完全透明图像，真实消息采集尚未验收；这与窗口是否激活分开记录。Apple 已将 title: Authority and sandbox
group: Design › Security and engineering › Security and permissions
text: Execution authority and sandbox Execution permissions Execution authority, permission, and sandbox Authenticated authority One operation decision Permission modes Versioned live permission lifecycle Tool and host boundaries Sandbox escalation Reference corpus and choices Failures and compatibility Files and acceptance boundaries Implementation status Chinese Execution authority and sandbox Authenticated requests, consistent tool decisions, and live permission changes. Sections Execution authority, permission, and sandbox Authenticated authority One operation decision Permission modes Versioned live permission lifecycle Tool and host boundaries Sandbox escalation Reference corpus and choices Failures and compatibility Files and acceptance boundaries Implementation status Chinese Execution authority, permission, and sandbox This is the canonical engineering contract for request identity, tool approvals, live permission changes, and local process isolation. It covers Web, CLI, ACP, channels, nested Agents, scheduled tasks, and continuation. Permission changes do not redesign host isolation or add speculative capability tiers. Authority: the authenticated principal and fixed capability ceiling. Permission: allow, ask, classify, or deny one operation. Sandbox: the resources an approved process can access. Authenticated authority Authenticated local entries attach the complete owner authority to TurnRequest before durable admission. The audit actor and the execution request are separate values; providing only an admission actor does not authorize tools. Paired channels retain the paired tier; browser MCP grants may use mcp_browser. Nested requests inherit and cannot expand authority. Missing or unknown authority fails closed with a stable reason code. Recovery never reconstructs owner authority from a source label or from model text. 升级与精确审批 参考框架与取舍 失败与兼容性 代码职责与验收 实现状态 English 执行权限与沙箱 本文定义请求身份、工具审批、运行中权限更新和本地进程隔离。Authority 表示认证主体及能力上限；Permission 判定一次操作；Sandbox 限制获准进程可访问的资源。适用范围包括 Web、CLI、ACP、渠道、嵌套 Agent、定时任务和恢复执行。 认证身份 本地认证入口在持久化 admission 之前将完整 owner 身份写入 TurnRequest。审计 actor 与工具请求是不同字段，仅传 actor 不能授权工具。paired 渠道保留自己的权限级别，浏览器 MCP 可缩窄为 mcp_browser。嵌套请求继承身份且不能扩大权限。缺失或未知身份必须返回明确拒绝，恢复流程不能根据 source 或模型文字补成 owner。 统一操作判定 审批等待与工具执行共用同一判定函数。顺序为：固定约束、Authority、计划模式只读限制、显式 deny、显式 ask 或强制审批、精确 Web Use 授权、bypass、显式 allow、定时 Memory 例外、安全读取、acceptEdits、Auto 分类、普通审批。非交互请求不能要求本地审批。bypass 只跳过普通审批与 Auto 分类，显式规则、强制审批、插件 gate 和 Sandbox 仍生效。非法模式更新必须拒绝。 Web 答复只有在规范等待命令确认 applied 后才移除问题。发送结果未知时锁定答复，使用相同命令标识重试；仅写入连接不代表完成。审批、普通提问、表单和讨论均遵循该约束。 权限模式 ask 放行安全读取，其他操作要求审批。acceptEdits 额外放行工作目录内支持的安全编辑。plan 按既有只读工具策略拒绝副作用。auto 放行安全工具，其余执行风险分类。bypass 跳过普通审批与风险分类。有效模式按会话、项目、ask 的优先级解析；实际 admission 和界面确认必须使用相同的有效值。 带版本的运行中权限 现有 SessionStore 持久化 permission_state，包含模式、版本和 owner principal。原子 compare-and-set 拒绝过时客户端的修改。设置入口验证认证身份、会话范围和预期版本。工具在下一次审批检查读取该身份所属的最新设置，单个调用保留检查结果直到执行；已获准的调用不被中途取消。原始身份、admission 和恢复合同保持不可变。其他会话、paired 渠道及非交互任务不能使用这些动态放宽。 切换模式后，只重新判断普通权限审批。现在允许的调用通过既有 canonical wait-answer 命令恢复。显式 ask、强制审批、Sandbox 升级和用户问题不自动回答。若更新与等待创建交错，旧执行释放 cancellation token 后再次检查；启动恢复也检查尚未处理的持久化变更。已结束、取消或超时的任务不会重新执行。 界面区分请求中、确认模式和错误；较旧的版本不能覆盖新状态。未发送的草稿只保存本地选择，首次发送时传入。已有会话必须等待后端确认。计划模式在工具边界实施，因此能阻止模型已经提出但尚未获准的写入；工具目录保持稳定以支持中途退出计划模式和恢复执行。模型主动进入的计划状态仍需要批准 exit_plan_mode。每次后续模型请求也包含最新确认模式的运行时说明。 Web 和默认 App 在已有后端确认版本时立即发送权限修改，只有未知版本时才先读取。后端确认是生效边界，与模型是否正在推理或生成无关。确认后的每次普通工具审批检查使用新模式，包括同一批生成结果中的后续调用；无需重启模型请求或等待下一条用户消息。版本冲突仍返回错误，界面不把尚未确认的选择显示为有效模式。 工具与宿主边界 文件工具执行进程内检查；macOS 子进程使用 Seatbelt，Linux 使用 bubblewrap。Browser/Web Use 使用精确 surface 授权。Docker 与 SSH 使用各自的执行边界；owner 配置的 MCP 进程不等于本地 Sandbox。workspace-write 限制写根、保护读取、过滤凭证环境并默认关闭网络；danger-full-access 使用宿主用户

title: Workflow overview

text: Self-Programming Agentic Workflow — Design overview Overview Programs code structure Programming model and composition Discovery, creation and automatic execution DAG and Programs Agent tool configuration OpenProgram · Runtime design set Self-Programming Agentic Workflow A Workflow is a small ordinary Python project in its own Git repository. It uses the existing @agentic_function , calls other projects through normal imports, and combines goal() , agent() and llm() as the task requires. The detailed design is organized into three topic pages. Sole decorator: @agentic_function Composition: Python import Versioning: Git commits Four management entry points separated Category migration and App acceptance in progress 1. Design questions and boundaries The system manages multiple reusable Workflows. A Workflow can call another Workflow or directly call ordinary Functions, single model requests, Agent loops and Goal loops. Callers should not learn another API, and generated code should not pass string names to an additional dispatcher. Public code has one meaning: import Python functions and call them. OpenProgram prepares importable code, establishes the Runtime context, records the DAG and isolates the execution environment. Out of scope: Workflow DSLs, custom revision databases, remote Marketplaces, automatic push, background distributed scheduling and new model-tool protocols. 2. Current implementation and remaining differences Current facts Remaining differences Target page @agentic_function Python calls, tool registration, Runtime inheritance and the DAG are supported. An earlier design redundantly added @workflow and a call adaptation layer; these have been removed from the target design. title: Workflow authoring
group: Design › Agents and workflows › Programs and workflows
text: Workflow discovery, creation, and automatic execution design Overview Programs code structure Programming model and composition Discovery, creation, and automatic execution DAG and Programs Agent tool configuration Self-Programming Workflow · architecture and implementation plan Separate Workflow discovery, creation, revision, and execution This page defines how the OpenProgram Chat Agent selects existing Workflows, creates reusable Workflows on demand, and lets users manually trigger the complete process through auto_workflow(task) . Selection, creation, revision, and execution must be independent public operations. The complete entry point only orchestrates them and retains no second implementation. Status: source implementation and re-review complete · App acceptance pending Scope: Workflow catalog / authoring / runtime / Programs UI Audience: Runtime, Programs, and Web implementers Compatibility: read-only recovery of legacy runs Design decisions Parameter ownership Current implementation Target architecture Public contracts Creation and reuse Lifecycle Framework comparison Implementation plan Acceptance Implementation status 1. Design decisions Remove the entry point for new agentic_workflow calls. Separate its capabilities into search_workflows , create_workflow , revise_workflow and execution of a specific Workflow; also provide a complete auto_workflow entry point for manual user use only. Chat Agent path Agent → search / create / revise / workflow The Agent decides whether to call an existing Program directly. Search only when the catalog is large or candidates are not loaded. The Agent does not call auto_workflow . Manual user path User → auto_workflow(task) One request performs search, one visible selection, creation if needed, and execution. Every step remains independently visible in the DAG. auto_workflow is a convenience orchestration entry, not a candidate Workflow or component. title: 工作流编写
group: 设计 › Agent 与工作流 › 程序与工作流
text: Workflow 发现、创建与自动执行设计 总览 Programs 代码结构 编程模型与组合 发现、创建与自动执行 DAG 与 Programs Agent 工具配置 自编程工作流 · 架构与实施计划 拆分 Workflow 的发现、创建、修订与执行 本页定义 OpenProgram 如何让 Chat Agent 选择已有 Workflow、如何按需创建可复用 Workflow，以及用户如何通过 auto_workflow(task) 手动触发完整流程。核心约束是：选择、创建、修订和执行必须是独立公共行为；完整入口只做编排，不再保存另一套实现。 状态：源码实现与复审完成 · App 验收待完成 范围：Workflow catalog / authoring / runtime / Programs UI 读者：Runtime、Programs、Web 实现者 兼容：旧 run 只读恢复 设计结论 参数归属 当前实现 目标架构 公共合同 创建与复用 生命周期 框架对照 实施计划 验收 实现状态 1. 设计结论 删除新的 agentic_workflow 调用入口。 将其能力拆为 search_workflows 、 create_workflow 、 revise_workflow 和具体 Workflow 执行；另提供只供用户手动使用的 auto_workflow 完整入口。 Chat Agent 路径 Agent → 搜索 / 创建 / 修订 / 工作流 Agent自己判断是否直接调用已有Program；目录较大或候选未加载时才搜索。Agent不调用 auto_workflow 。 用户手动路径 用户 → auto_workflow(task) 一次请求完成搜索、一次可见选择、必要时创建、随后执行；每一步仍在DAG中独立可见。 auto_workflow 是便捷编排入口，不是候选 Workflow，也不是组件。搜索结果必须排除它，生成代码不得 import 它，Agent 工具集合不得暴露它。 workflow/ 只用于按代码类型归类。目录、辅助文件和内部子目录都不是 Program；Programs、Registry 和调用图只把实际注册的 @agentic_function 作为可运行实体。目录层级不得改变公开名称、调用方式或运行语义。 工作流参数归属 用户提供任务、证据和交付要求。执行参数归工作流管理，不通过高级选项、设置对话框或参数提问暴露给用户。 工作流有多个依赖任务的参数时，在执行前发起一次不带工具的模型请求，生成完整计划。提供真实运行时能力与应用限制，验证每个字段及跨字段约束；输出无效或规划失败时应用完整回退方案，并传播取消。固定不变量仍由代码控制，模型不得修改权限、凭证或应用上限。在可恢复工作开始前持久化生效计划，恢复时复用。 规范开发示例、参数契约和验收清单位于 工作流编写 。缺失任务事实时可以澄清，但不得将执行调优交给用户。 2. 当前实现与已确认缺口 当前事实 问题 目标处理 公开入口是 search_workflows 、 create_workflow 、 revise_workflow 和用户级 auto_workflow ；旧 agentic_workflow 不再注册。 resume_workflow 保留为内部函数。 旧名称没有说明它会搜索、生成、发布并执行。 新调用走四个明确入口；历史 run 只读恢复。 只读搜索、create/revise 发布和具体 Workflow 执行是独立公共行为； auto_workflow 只编排这些入口，不再保存另一套实现。 只读发现、持久写入和业务执行不得共享一个生命周期。 按公共合同拆行为；不再存在复合执行路径。 已有项目以 Git revision、snapshot 和 project_ref.json 固定运行输入。 版本和恢复能力必须独立于编排入口。 保留项目格式、快照、checkpoint 和显式 resume。 普通执行失败保留原错误和 checkpoint，不改写已发布 Workflow。 一次普通执行不得静默修改已发布源码。 发布前结构/测试修复留在 create；已发布修改只能显式 revise。 auto_workflow 出现在用户表单和 Programs 页（自动入口 · 仅用户手动），不出现在 Agent 工具清单。 Model calls = 0 Agentic Function A single-model capability consisting of a prompt and minimal deterministic code, replacing some first-party text Skills. Exactly one llm() call Workflow Compositions containing multistep control flow, Agent tool loops, Goals, multiple model calls, file side effects or persistence. Complex execution belongs only here @agentic_function is the existing registration decorator, not permission for arbitrary Agent behavior. title: Self-updates
group: Design › Agents and workflows › Programs and workflows
text: OpenProgram In-Conversation Self-Update OpenProgram / Self update Scope Current state User flow Architecture Workflow Post-failure execution Subsequent updates Design decisions State and storage Sequence Acceptance Acceptance tools Failure recovery Security boundaries Interfaces State and session recovery References Implementation plan Completion conditions Implementation status Authoritative design · runtime Official Release updates remain defined by distribution/automatic-updates.html. Runtime architecture · owner initiated · macOS v1 In-conversation self-update A user asks an Agent in OpenProgram to modify OpenProgram. The Agent edits, tests, and commits in an isolated worktree; a worker-independent controller builds and installs the complete App. After the new worker starts, it automatically creates an acceptance task to check the original objective. System-check or goal-acceptance failure restores the old App. Core constraint: The worker being replaced cannot complete its own replacement. Persist handoff and pause checkpoints for other tasks before restart, then create a new acceptance task with provenance. After verification, resume compatible tasks from checkpoints and create a follow-up for the initiating session. Platform Default macOS App /Applications/OpenProgram.app · :18100 · ~/.openprogram Candidate Local Git commit Isolated worktree; dirty candidates prohibited Activation Complete App bundle No wheel/asar incremental paths in v1 Concurrency One active update Installation lock + update id + idempotent recovery Question How can an owner authorize framework changes in chat, followed automatically by build, stopping the old instance, App replacement, restart, acceptance Agent execution, and failure handling? Audience Runtime, Desktop, Job/DAG, permission, and local-release maintainers. title: Management comparison
text: Management comparison # A comprehensive comparison of the session management mechanisms across four projects: Claude Code, OpenCode, OpenClaw, and OpenProgram (our design). 1. Storage Format # Claude Code OpenCode OpenClaw OpenProgram Storage medium Filesystem (one JSONL per session) SQLite database (single file opencode.db ) JSON registry ( sessions.json ) + one JSONL per session Git repository (one directory per session) + JSON registry ( index.json ) Metadata location Mixed into the JSONL ( ai-title , custom-title , mode , and other entries) sessions table (10 fields) The SessionEntry in sessions.json (around 70 fields) meta.json (inside each session directory) + index.json (registry cache) Message location Same JSONL file ( user , assistant entries) Dedicated messages table + parts column (JSON array) Dedicated <id>.jsonl transcript file Git history (one file per message, DAG structure) File snapshots file-history-snapshot entries in the JSONL Dedicated files table (path, content, version) None Git worktree (each session can have its own working directory) Storage path ~/.claude/projects/<slug>/<uuid>.jsonl <data_dir>/opencode.db <state>/agents/<id>/sessions/sessions.json + <id>.jsonl <state>/sessions/<id>/ (meta.json + history/) + <state>/sessions/index.json Metadata/message separation Not separated, all in one file Separated (different tables) Separated (different files) Separated (meta.json vs history/) 2. Session Metadata Fields # Field category Claude Code OpenCode OpenClaw OpenProgram id JSONL filename (UUID) sessions.id (UUID) sessionId id (UUID) Title Two separate entries, aiTitle + customTitle Single sessions.title field displayName + label Single title field Title priority customTitle > aiTitle > summaryHint > firstPrompt > id Last value written displayName > label Last value written (truncation / LLM / manual — all three sources override equally) Created time timestamp of the first message in the JSONL sessions.created_at startedAt created_at Updated

text: 管理方案对比 # Claude Code、OpenCode、OpenClaw、OpenProgram（我们的设计）四个项目的 session 管理机制全面对比。 1. 存储格式 # Claude Code OpenCode OpenClaw OpenProgram 存储介质 文件系统（每 session 一个 JSONL） SQLite 数据库（单文件 opencode.db ） JSON 注册表（ sessions.json ）+ 每 session 一个 JSONL Git 仓库（每 session 一个目录）+ JSON 注册表（ index.json ） 元数据位置 混在 JSONL 里（ ai-title 、 custom-title 、 mode 等条目） sessions 表（10 个字段） sessions.json 里的 SessionEntry（约 70 个字段） meta.json （每 session 目录内）+ index.json （注册表缓存） 消息位置 同一个 JSONL 文件（ user 、 assistant 条目） 独立的 messages 表 + parts 列（JSON 数组） 独立的 <id>.jsonl transcript 文件 Git history（每消息一个文件，DAG 结构） 文件快照 JSONL 里的 file-history-snapshot 条目 独立的 files 表（path, content, version） 无 Git worktree（每 session 可有独立工作目录） 存储路径 ~/.claude/projects/<slug>/<uuid>.jsonl <data_dir>/opencode.db <state>/agents/<id>/sessions/sessions.json + <id>.jsonl <state>/sessions/<id>/ （meta.json + history/）+ <state>/sessions/index.json 元数据与消息分离 不分离，全在一个文件 分离（不同表） 分离（不同文件） 分离（meta.json vs history/） 2. Session 元数据字段 # 字段类别 Claude Code OpenCode OpenClaw OpenProgram id JSONL 文件名（UUID） sessions.id （UUID） sessionId id （UUID） 标题 aiTitle + customTitle 两个独立条目 sessions.title 单字段 displayName + label title 单字段 标题优先级 customTitle > aiTitle > summaryHint > firstPrompt > id 最后写入的值 displayName > label 最后写入的值（截取 / LLM / 手动三个来源平等覆盖） 创建时间 JSONL 首条消息的 timestamp sessions.created_at startedAt created_at 更新时间 文件 mtime 或 sidecar sessions.updated_at （trigger 自动） updatedAt （应用层写入） updated_at （应用层写入） 消息计数 无 sessions.message_count （trigger 自动 +1/-1） 无 无 token 统计 无（在 usage 里但不汇总） prompt_tokens / completion_tokens / cost inputTokens / outputTokens / totalTokens / estimatedCostUsd / cacheRead / cacheWrite / contextTokens 无（由独立的 UsageLedger 子系统管理） 运行状态 ~/.claude/sessions/<pid>.json 里的 status （idle/busy） 无 status （running/done/failed/killed/timeout） status 枚举（idle/running/needs_input/done/failed，dispatcher 写入，启动时重置） 父子关系 无 parent_session_id （title 生成和 task 用子 session） spawnedBy / parentSessionKey / spawnDepth （0=主, 1=子agent, 2=子子agent） 无 渠道/来源 无 无 channel / groupId

title: Context
text: Context # session_context is the unified per-turn context manager. It populates the ContextVars ( _store / _current_turn_id / _current_runtime / _call_id ) so that capabilities such as feeding docstrings into the prompt, DAG persistence, and ask_user tracking take effect across all entry points. Interface # @contextmanager def session_context ( session_id : str | None = None , * , agent_id : str = "main" , turn_id : str | None = None , runtime = None , create_runtime_if_none : bool = True , ): db = default_db () sid = session_id or ( "adhoc_" + _short_uuid ()) if db . get_session ( sid ) is None : db . create_session ( sid , agent_id , source = "cli" ) rt = runtime if rt is None and create_runtime_if_none : rt = create_runtime () tid = turn_id or ( "turn_" + _short_uuid ()) tokens = [] tokens . append (( "_store" , _store . set ( SessionNodeWriter ( db , sid )))) tokens . append (( "_turn" , _current_turn_id . set ( tid ))) if rt is not None : tokens . append (( "_rt" , _current_runtime . set ( rt ))) try : yield SessionHandle ( db = db , session_id = sid , runtime = rt , turn_id = tid ) finally : for _name , tok in reversed ( tokens ): tok . var . reset ( tok ) When the session does not exist, session_context calls create_session — this is one of the creation entry points described in operations.md . Session boundaries # Boundaries are determined by how session_id is passed, not by the number of calls. Caller intent What to pass Behavior Run a new task Do not pass session_id Creates a new one and returns/prints the id to the caller Continue the same task (2nd, 3rd call) Pass the id returned last time Reuses it, continuing the history Start something unrelated Do not pass one (or pass a different id) A separate, new session CLI equivalent: the first run without --session prints a new id; --session <id> continues.
